# Onbook AI

> Onbook (onbook.ai) is AI outreach that books you sales meetings. It finds companies with a real reason to hear from you now (a raise, a hire, a launch, a new office) and writes to the right people from your own LinkedIn, X and email, a few each weekday at a safe pace. The moment anyone at a company replies or books, everyone there stops hearing from you. Built for Web3 agencies, Web2 agencies, B2B services and SaaS teams without a full-time SDR. Currently a waitlist; free to set up until you launch.
